entities.name: Identification procedure

entities.name: IDENTITY RESPONSE message
entities.description: Message sent by UE in response to identity request from network

entities.name: Identity type
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of identity being provided

entities.name: No identity available
entities.description: Condition where UE cannot encode requested identity due to no valid USIM

entities.name: Encode identity type as 'no identity'
entities.description: UE behavior when requested identity is not available

entities.name: Transmission failure indication from lower layers
entities.description: Condition where lower layers indicate transmission failure of IDENTITY RESPONSE

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure for updating UE's tracking area information

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to attach to the network

entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to request services from network

entities.name: TAI change condition
entities.description: Condition where current TAI is not in TAI list

entities.name: Abort identification procedure
entities.description: UE behavior to terminate the identification procedure

relations.description: Identification procedure involves sending IDENTITY RESPONSE message
IDENTITY RESPONSE message contains identity type information element
When no identity is available, UE encodes identity type as 'no identity'
Transmission failure causes UE to abort identification procedure
After aborting identification, UE re-initiates tracking area updating procedure
After aborting identification, UE re-initiates attach procedure
TAI change condition triggers tracking area updating procedure
Identification procedure can be triggered by service request procedure
Identification procedure can be triggered by tracking area updating procedure
Identification procedure can be triggered by attach procedure
